blurb: The Bronson-Mulholland House is a stunningly furnished antebellum home sitting on acres of greenspace overhung with live oaks and magnolias. Owned by the City of Palatka, it is available for touring Thursday-Monday as well as rental for weddings and other events. Also known as the Judge Isaac H. Bronson House and as Sunny Point, it is an historic site located at 100 Madison Street, in Palatka, Florida.
